name: Cross-over step
summary: A big step across to reach a very wide forehand.
whenToUse: When the ball goes so wide to your forehand that side steps are too slow, often after a pivot.

keyPoints.stance: From ready or from the backhand corner after a pivot.
keyPoints.bodyAction: Weight onto the right foot (left foot if left-handed), then swing the left foot (right foot if left-handed) across in front of it toward the wide forehand, turning the hips as you go.
keyPoints.strokeLength: Footwork only; play the forehand as the crossing foot lands.
keyPoints.timing: Go early: the step takes time.
keyPoints.tablePosition: From the backhand side to the wide forehand.
keyPoints.batArm: Already back as you land, ready to swing.
keyPoints.recovery: Side steps back toward the middle.
keyPoints.anticipation: Expect the wide ball after you pivot.

learningPath.passCheck: You can say the three cues.

learningPath.task: Cross-over between markers with a shadow forehand.
learningPath.passCheck: 8 reps each side, then yes to the self-checks.
selfChecks: Did the foot cross in front?
Did you play as it landed?
Did you recover with side steps?

learningPath.task: Backhand corner, then wide forehand, slowly.

gamePatterns.situation: You pivot to play a forehand from the backhand corner and the ball comes back wide to your forehand.
gamePatterns.how: Cross-over, play a safe forehand cross-court, side step back.

fixes: Move as soon as you see the wide ball
Two side steps back to the middle
